bad.title: The first idea is the only idea
bad.text: The last ten workflows under File is the obvious answer, and nothing else gets tried.

bad.title: Round 4, same recent list
bad.text: Icons, dates and sorting make it neater, but no round questions the list itself.
bad.wait: Press Polish three times to see this.

good.title: One request, three subagents
good.text: They work at the same time, so three directions cost the time of one.

good.title: Search, a different kind of answer
good.text: Typing part of a name finds any workflow, open or closed, not just the last ten.
good.wait: Press Ask for three to see this.

good.title: A shortcut nobody would polish into
good.text: Ctrl+Shift+T brings back closed tabs, a path no round of polish would reach.
good.wait: Press Ask for three to see this.

bad.title: The same brief, word for word
bad.text: “Make failed downloads more visible” three times sends every agent down the same obvious path.

bad.title: Three red toasts
bad.text: Only the icon and the position change. It looks like three options, but it’s one idea.
bad.wait: Press Run all three to see this.

good.title: A different bet per subagent
good.text: Never interrupt, fix in one step, warn where people look next. Each pulls a different way.

good.title: A dot, a Retry, a warning
good.text: A red dot on Downloads, Retry on the failed row, or a warning in the workflow that needs the file.
good.wait: Press Run all three to see this.

bad.title: Copy link looks ready to ship
bad.text: A real link, a Copy button and avatars pull the eye before anyone weighs the idea.

bad.title: Invite by email stays a sketch
bad.text: Editing the same workflow together might be the better idea, but it can’t compete on looks.

good.title: Copy link, at sketch level too
good.text: No real link or avatars, so it wins only if the idea does.

good.title: The choice rests on the idea
good.text: Whichever card gets picked, the reason is what it does, not how finished it looks.
good.wait: Press Pick on any card to see this.

bad.title: One more, with no stopping point
bad.text: Every press adds a card, and nothing says when there are enough.

bad.title: 7 directions, none chosen
bad.text: A guided tour, a search box and an import area pile on, each adding less than the last.
bad.wait: Press One more four times to see this.

good.title: The plan comes before the asking
good.text: Ask for 4, keep 2. The end of exploring is set from the start.

good.title: Keep stops at two
good.text: A third Keep is refused until one is dropped, so the plan holds.

good.title: Two kept, the rest dim
good.text: The two picks go further, and the other two are set aside on purpose.
good.wait: Press Keep on two cards to see this.

bad.title: “Three versions” of what, exactly
bad.text: No direction to vary along, so each agent rewrites the same toast.

bad.title: Three toasts, same corner
bad.text: “Export done!”, “Your export is ready” and “Export complete.” None is easier to notice.

good.title: An axis from silent to blocking
good.text: Four named points, so each agent knows how loud its version should be.

good.title: A dot, a toast, a banner, a dialog
good.text: Each step is louder, so a test can find where people start to notice.

bad.title: Every cell says “2 files missing”
bad.text: Same words, same place, same moment. Only the color and the corners change.

bad.title: Pick two, notice nothing
bad.text: Someone opening the workflow sees the same message at the same moment either way.
bad.wait: Pick two cells to see this.

good.title: Icon on input, as soon as it opens
good.text: A warning on each missing input, right where the file is needed.

good.title: Picks differ in what people see
good.text: Icon on input against Dialog changes both where and when, and people would notice.
good.wait: Pick two cells to see this.

bad.title: B changes all four at once
bad.text: Loud, when idle, a dialog and new words. Any of them could explain its score.

bad.title: B wins, and nobody knows why
bad.text: 4.1 against 3.0 and 2.6, with no way to tell which change earned it.
bad.wait: Press Show the test results to see this.

good.title: Place and wording held still
good.text: Every option says “Update ready” in the top bar, so neither can explain a score.

good.title: Each neighbor answers one question
good.text: A against B shows waiting until idle helped. C and D show loudness hurt.
good.wait: Press Show the test results to see this.

bad.title: Crossed out before anyone read it
bad.text: Pause midway and Dialog after look odd, so they’re dropped unopened.

bad.title: Nothing left to learn from
bad.text: Dialog after could have shown why the quiet note after works. Now nobody will know.
bad.wait: Pick Dialog after to see this.

good.title: Dialog after, still on the grid
good.text: It looks too late to help, but it gets a look before anyone drops it.

good.title: The odd cell explains its neighbor
good.text: People care about space after the download, which is why the quiet note after works.
good.wait: Pick Dialog after to see this.

bad.title: The 4 seconds live in a note
bad.text: Frame 2 of 3 can show the toast, but the timing exists only as text.

bad.title: An Undo nobody can press
bad.text: Clicking it does nothing, so nobody learns if there’s time to read and react.

good.title: A real timer, not a note
good.text: The 4 seconds actually run, so the question gets answered by trying.

good.title: Undo works, with a draining bar
good.text: The bar shows the time left, so people feel whether 4 seconds is enough.

bad.title: Each Build costs a full day
bad.text: Comparing three ideas means three branches before anyone sees one.

bad.title: 3 days, two of them wasted
bad.text: Two of the three branches get deleted once one direction is picked.
bad.wait: Build all three, then pick one, to see this.

good.title: Each sketch takes 10 minutes
good.text: Three directions side by side in half an hour, and cheap to throw away.

good.title: One branch, for the winner
good.text: It stays off until a sketch is picked, so only one day of code gets written.

good.title: 30 minutes, then one day
good.text: The only work thrown away is two 10-minute sketches.
good.wait: Sketch all three, pick one, then build it to see this.

bad.title: A description, not a question
bad.text: It says what the prototype is, but not what it should find out.

bad.title: Dark mode, animations, a settings page
bad.text: Three hours in, and none of it helps learn whether people find Reopen closed tab.
bad.wait: Press Add something three times to see this.

good.title: The question comes first
good.text: Do people find Reopen closed tab without help? Anything else can wait.

good.title: Dark mode gets skipped
good.text: It doesn’t help answer the question, so no time goes into it.

good.title: Three people end the prototype
good.text: All three find it in under ten seconds, and the work stops there.

bad.title: A hack that saves every keystroke
bad.text: Fine for testing an idea, not for everyone who types a draft.

bad.title: No tests behind it
bad.text: Nothing checks that a draft survives closing the tab.

bad.title: The shortcuts ship to everyone
bad.text: Every draft now gets logged, and the next change can break saving unnoticed.
bad.wait: Press Merge as it is to see this.

good.title: Rewrite with tests, from main
good.text: A fresh branch that saves after a pause, and the prototype branch is deleted.

good.title: Or keep it, with a full review
good.text: The hack and the logging come out, and a reviewer approves it like any change.

good.title: A test for what people liked
good.text: A Playwright spec checks that a draft survives closing the tab.
good.wait: Press Rewrite with tests to see this.
